howToVerify: See README.md > The public registry. A report's digest is sha256 over its canonical JSON (sort_keys, compact separators) with report_hash and generated removed.

entries.note: Reference implementation; self-run conformance, not an independent audit. Counts are the config pacland actually carries (3 gates, 6 guards), not a manifest claim: before 2026-10-26 this entry said 5/5 and 4 while the config had one working gate and an ineffective guard. Adoption is one valiant.json: the licensed SOP baseline ships inside the SDK and is verified there, and its six guards' proofs are produced by `valiant mutate`, not typed by hand.

entries.deficit: not applicable — a build system makes claims, not measurements (see report §3)
entries.note: First non-model entry: verified as gates + guards + ledger. Its proofs are produced by the rig's own runner and now CARRY a re-execution recipe (file, find, replace, check), so the SDK re-runs them rather than trusting the file: 33 proofs, 33 red, every one replayed. A seeded sample was also re-executed on 2026-10-26 (seed 20261026, 3/3). No m and no radius: inventing observables to fit the schema would be the fault this project exists to catch.
